lawyer: Md. Fazlul Karim with A.M M.M. Rahim For the State.
parties:
Mina Bibi alias Amena Bibi and ors ----- Accused-Appellants
Vs.
State ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 2. The case for the prosecution in brief is that deceased Nurun Nahar alias Shamsunnahar, wife of Monsur Ali used to live in village Gholdaha P.S. Fulchhori, Gaibandha, Dist. Rangpur, P.W. 4 Jobeda Khatun is the mother of deceased Nurun Nahar. Informant P.W. 1 Saidur Rahman is a cousin of deceased Nurun Nabar. Accused appellant Azizul Haque is the maternal cousin of the deceased while accused appellant Amina Bibi is the maternal aunt of the deceased. On 19-9-72 corresponding to the 1st Aswin, 1379 B.S. at about 4 P.M. deceased Nurun Nahar went to bring water from the neighboring tubewell. At that time Momena, daughter of accused appellant Amina Bibi also went to bring water Nurun Nahar and Momena had a quarrel over the question of sharing water. Deceased Nurun Nahar obstructed Momena and slapped her. Momena went and complained to her father, mother and brothers, Momena's father Mojoruddin came to the tube-well along with his wife appellant Amena Bibi, his son appellant Azizul Haque and another son Abuzol Hoque, Accused appellant Azizul Haque gave a blow by 'dang' (stick) on Nurun Nahar who fell down. Accused appellant Amina, wife of Mojoruddin sat on her chest and began to press the throat of Nurun Nahar. Nurun Nahar became senseless. The accused appellants along with their relations went away. P.W. 7 Joinuddin and one Jalil took Nuran Nahar to her father's house where she expired within a short time, P.W. 1 Saidur Rahman lodged F.I.R. at the Fulchhori on 19.9.72 at 10 A.M. Sub-Inspector Golam Mehdi, Officer- in-Charge, P.S. Fulchhori took up investigation of the case. He went to the locality on the same day i.e. on 19.9.72 and held inquest on the dead body of Nurun Nahar in the court yard of the house of her father. P.W. 11 Dr. Shah Aminul Islam, Sub-Divisional Medical Officer, Gaibanda held post mortem examination on the dead body of Nuran Nahar @ Shamsun Nahar on 20.9.72, He found a bruise on the front of the chest, another bruise on the fount of left shoulder, another abrasion on left cheek, diffused swellings on both sides of the neck and lacerated wound on the head. Death in the opinion of the said doctor was due to asphyxia (throttling) and shock as a result of the injuries which were ante mortem and homicidal in nature. The Investigating Officer (P.W. 10) prepared a sketch map of the locality, examined witnesses and handed over charge of the case to Sub-Inspector Abdul Haque at the time of going away on transfer. Sub-Inspector Abdul Haque submitted charge-sheet against the two accused appellants and two others, namely, Mojoruddin and Abuzol Haque on 1-2-73. A competent Magistrate held preliminary enquiry into the case and committed the two appellants to the court of Sessions for trial after discharging accused Mojoruddin and accused Abuzol Haque. At the time of trial accused appellants Azizul Haque and Amina Bibi were charged under section 302 of the Penal Code for causing the death of Nuran Nahar @ Shaaisun Nahar. The accused persons pleaded not guilty.
